claim: Z80N opcodes the simulator lacks (e.g. SWAPNIB, ED 23) must be simulated and self-tested exhaustively, with a control that runs the hooks with the opcode as a NOP.

evidence.text: Z80N SWAPNIB (ED 23), the nibble swap in the pixel converter, is simulated by rainbow._swapnib with an exhaustive self-test; a SWAPNIB-as-NOP control exists.
evidence.quote: Z80N SWAPNIB (ED 23) | nibble swap in the pixel converter (simulated by rainbow._swapnib; exhaustive self-test)
